components.name: Button
components.summary: Recipe-reference interactive control — Radix Slot polymorphism, primary/ghost visual weight, sm/md sizing.

props.name: variant
props.doc: Visual weight: primary = accent fill (one of the <=10% accent slots), ghost = hairline.

props.name: asChild
props.doc: Render as the single child element instead of a <button> (Radix Slot); the child must accept className and data-* attributes.

a11yNotes: Defaults the native type to "button" so it never accidentally submits a form.
Under asChild, the slotted child element must accept className and data-* attributes for the kit's styling to apply.

components.name: Card
components.summary: Presentational panel primitive with an optional accent treatment and interactive hover affordance.

props.name: accent
props.doc: Accent treatment: accent border + tinted surface (one of the <=10% accent slots).

props.name: interactive
props.doc: Tonal-hover affordance: border brighten + surface step + lift (motion-tokened).

a11yNotes: Renders a single native <div> with no implicit ARIA role — presentational only, server-safe.

components.name: FormField
components.summary: Label + control + helper/error wrapper that wires id/aria association for any single form control.

props.name: helperText
props.doc: Supporting copy shown under the control; hidden while error is set.

props.name: error
props.doc: Validation failure message; marks the control aria-invalid and is announced via role="alert".

props.name: mono
props.doc: Render the control in the brand's control-id monospace, for id/key/token-shaped fields.

props.name: children
props.doc: The single form control — an <input>, <select>, or <textarea>.

a11yNotes: Associates the label to the control via htmlFor/id (React useId).
Wires aria-describedby to the helper or error text automatically.
Sets aria-invalid and role="alert" on the error message when error is present.
The error message replaces helperText rather than rendering both at once.

components.name: Terminal
components.summary: Framed evidence artifact — a chrome bar plus a monospace body, purely presentational.

props.name: label
props.doc: Chrome-bar label; also mirrored to the <pre> aria-label.

props.name: status
props.doc: A StatusChip or text rendered at the right of the chrome bar.

a11yNotes: Mirrors the chrome-bar label onto the <pre> aria-label so screen readers get the same context sighted users do.
